summary: Decoded the per-category data table for the skill-training screen header from the dispatch at wpcmk file 0x194c-0x199d. Four locals (iconLeft-1, iconRight-1, startSlot, endSlot, nameAttrParam) are written immediately for each of WEAPONRY/PHYSICAL/PERSONAL/ACADEMIA. Engine `INC AX` before drawing icons, so the table value is 1 less than the rendered char.

category_table.name: WEAPONRY
category_table.nameAttr: 0x20 (palette 2 = light blue, low nibble 0 = wfont0 highlight path)

category_table.name: PERSONAL
category_table.note: PERSONAL shares the same icon pair as PHYSICAL (0x25, 0x26).

encoding.iconChar: table_value + 1 (engine INC AX before push to draw call at 0x19cf and 0x19e5)
encoding.skillName: drawn via call at 0x1a27 with attr = nameAttrParam (raw value, which the renderer encodes as attrParam<<4 in cells)
encoding.categoryHeaderName: msg id = SKILL_CAT_BASE (0x0258) + categoryIdx, drawn at row 1 cols 6-13 attr 0x03
encoding.skillRowLoop: for slot in startSlot..endSlot inclusive: msg id = 0x157c + slot at attr nameAttr; bonus value = byte at DGROUP 0x55a4 + slot rendered width-3 at col 16-18 attr 0x10

findings.claim: Per-category data (icons, skill range, name attr) is set by four 5-MOV blocks in creation_stage_dispatcher_by_step at wpcmk file 0x194c/0x1967/0x1982/0x199d
findings.evidence: Raw disassembly of wpcmk.ovr file offset 0x18e5..0x1a89 dispatched via CMP AX,0..3 / JZ chain at 0x19b8..0x19ca. Each block writes 5 stack locals at [BP-4]..[BP-C].

findings.claim: Engine stores iconChar-1 and INCs before drawing; table char 0x01 → renders 0x02, table 0x24 → 0x25, etc.
findings.evidence: wpcmk 0x19cc-0x19e9: MOV AX,[BP-4]; INC AX; PUSH AX; ... ui_put_styled_char_at

findings.claim: Skill-row name attr is per-category: WEAPONRY=0x20, PHYSICAL=0xe0, PERSONAL=0xc0, ACADEMIA=0xb0
findings.evidence: [BP-C] passed as attr to ui_load_and_print_msg_at_xy at 0x1a27..0x1a34; cell dumps of slot 1 (WEAPONRY → attr 0x20) and slot 2 (PHYSICAL → attr 0xe0) verify the encoding.

findings.claim: Initial xp at character creation is 0, not 1 — DOSBox save 2 *0x547c 32-bit reads 0
findings.evidence: Direct memory read of DGROUP+0x547c..0x547f in save 2 = 0; rendered as '0' at top window row 2 col 38 attr 0x60.

findings.claim: Engine stores age as a 32-bit DAY count at DGROUP 0x5478; renders by dividing by 365 (cx=0x16d)
findings.evidence: wpcmk 0x0e44..0x0e54: MOV AX,[0x5478]; MOV DX,[0x547a]; MOV CX,0x16d; CALL long_idiv; PUSH AX. Save 2 *0x5478 = 6925 days → 18 years displayed.

findings.claim: The row-3 'second age' field reads *0x5496 16-bit directly (no division); transitions 0→1 between race-select and confirm
findings.evidence: wpcmk 0x0e8b PUSH word [0x5496]; saves 1+2 both show value 1 post-derived; race/class-select cell dumps show 0 pre-derived. Exact write point not yet RE'd.

unresolved: Exact write point where *0x5496 transitions 0→1 (presumably during the fireDerivedStats / portrait flow)
Whether *0x5496 represents real game-time, a player-action counter, or something else
